verdict.rationale: Deel can be driven headlessly through its REST API (e.g., POST /rest/contracts) using API tokens, which suit unattended CI use. It also offers an isolated sandbox with pre-populated data that can be reset to a clean state, and webhooks plus date-header API versioning make scripted automation predictable. Missing for 10: an official CLI, explicit CI/CD integration guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of headless automation.
